title: SOFIE · Digital Twin Control Room
description: Historical solar EV microgrid behavior, topology, and evidence.

options.content:
## SOFIE / DIGITAL TWIN CONTROL ROOM
**Historical replay · Europe/Berlin**   |   Solar EV microgrid · 8 wallboxes · 38.4 kWh battery   |   Select a time window to inspect measured behavior.

panels.title: Site topology · select a wallbox
panels.description: Configured site relationships. Node values come from the last measurement within the selected time range. Lines do not indicate measured power flow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time,solar_kw AS value FROM microgrid_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND solar_kw IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time,SUM(power_kw) AS value FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time,battery_soc_pct AS value FROM microgrid_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND battery_soc_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Wallboxes reporting
panels.description: Count of reporting wallboxes at the last observed minute; eight are configured.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time,COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: EV energy · window
panels.description: Integral of recorded minute-level wallbox power. Missing minutes are not estimated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,(SUM(power_kw)/60.0)::double precision AS value FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,MAX(solar_kw)::double precision AS value FROM microgrid_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Generation vs observed charging
panels.description: 15-minute averages. Charging covers reporting wallboxes, so the difference is not a site energy balance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'15m'),AVG(solar_kw) AS "PV output" FROM microgrid_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND solar_kw IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'15m'),AVG(total_kw) AS "Observed EV charging" FROM (SELECT ts,SUM(power_kw) AS total_kw FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts) s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'15m'),AVG(battery_soc_pct) AS "Battery SoC" FROM microgrid_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND battery_soc_pct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wallbox power · activity heatmap
panels.description: Mean power in adaptive time bins where a wallbox reported. Blank cells mean no source measurement, not zero load.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin(CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '30 days' THEN interval '1 day' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '15 minutes' END,ts,'2025-01-01'::timestamptz) AS bucket, wallbox_id,
    AVG(power_kw)::double precision AS avg_kw FROM charger_minute
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)  GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 8000

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'15m'),AVG(reporting)::double precision AS "Reporting wallboxes" FROM (SELECT m.ts,COUNT(c.wallbox_id) AS reporting FROM microgrid_minute m LEFT JOIN charger_minute c ON c.ts=m.ts WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts) GROUP BY m.ts) s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wallbox snapshot · power and event age
panels.description: Power must be observed in the selected window. Event age makes stale source status visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.id AS "Wallbox",ROUND(c.power_kw::numeric,2) AS "Power kW",c.ts AS "Power at",COALESCE(e.status,'Unknown') AS "Last event",e.ts AS "Event at",ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo() - e.ts))/60)::numeric,0) AS "Event age min" FROM wallbox w LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts,power_kw FROM charger_minute WHERE wallbox_id=w.id AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts,status FROM connector_event WHERE wallbox_id=w.id AND ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) e ON TRUE ORDER BY w.id

panels.title: Fault and error evidence
panels.description: No rows means no fault/error event recorded in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "Recorded at",wallbox_id AS "Wallbox",status AS "Status",error_code AS "Error" FROM connector_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (status='Faulted' OR (error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code <> 'NoError')) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

options.content:
### Evidence boundaries
**Measured:** PV output, battery SoC, wallbox power, connector events and charging transactions. **Partial:** EV load covers reporting wallboxes. **Unavailable:** measured inverter flow, other loads, full energy balance, forecast and live control. Use the Fleet and Data Trust dashboards for diagnosis.
